title: Describe the Robot
instructions:
Complete the `describe()` method in the `Robot` class so it returns the string "Robot: {name}" where `{name}` is the robot's name property.

For example, if the robot's name is "Tribot", `describe()` should return `"Robot: Tribot"`.
hint: Use a string template: "Robot: $name". The method can access `name` because it is a property of the same class.
